nom: Rael Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: By far the best cleansing balm on the market! It doesn't irritate the eyes and easily melts away makeup, including waterproof!
I have extremely sensitive skin.. ive tried so many cleansing balms & this is the only one that doesnt break my barrier! My skin felt incredibly soft & hydrated afterwards.

avis.titre: one of my new favorite cleansing balms
avis.texte: I've tried a TON of different cleansing balms/oils, and as a FULL beat kind of girl- this one is definitely one of my favorites. A black wing is my every day go to so a makeup remover that can melt away my heavy eyemakeup is a must! This balm gives me such a good clean without leaving my skin feeling stripped! It melts off my makeup without me having to scrub and pull at my skin! Definitely will repurchase!
Taking off makeup can be such a pain but this balm makes everything just melt right off!

This cleansing balm removes makeup and sunscreen so easily without leaving my skin feeling stripped. It melts into the skin, rinses clean, and leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated. Such a great first cleanse at the end of the day.

avis.titre: On My Fifth One....That's How Good It Is
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with the Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm. I've literally finished five of them already. It melts everything off, feels so soft on my skin, and the twist‑up stick makes cleansing way easier than it should be. Definitely a forever repurchase.

I love wearing makeup but removing it can be a pain. I always go through a bunch of wipes and other products just to remove my makeup at night. The Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm removes all of my makeup without drying out my skin or leaving it oily. It breaks down my makeup easily while not having to use a bunch of product. A lot goes a long way. It can easily replace my normal makeup remover! Definitely a new staple in my skincare routine! It makes my face feel cleaner and I don't have to keep going back in with different products just to make sure everything is removed because it gets the job done. My sensitive skin definitely approves!

I admit the twist up feature is nice but there's hardly any product in this. Normally when I buy a cleansing balm it lasts at least 3 months, usually longer, this lasted just over a month. It also did not take mascara & eye make up off very well.

avis.titre: 4.5 Stars — Great Option for Oily-Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I bought this on a whim because I'd heard good things about Rael and I was on a hunt for an effective oil cleanser. I've got extremely oily and textured skin, so I absolutely need a solid oil cleanser. This one was almost a five star. The packaging is clever and felt more hygienic. It melts easily into a lightweight oil that doesn't sting or burn in any way (for sensitive skin folks like me). I felt it didnt remove ALL traces of makeup, so it's necessary to double cleanse. In total, it lasted me about 3 months of use for daily washing.

avis.titre: Doesn't remove mascara or light bb cream
avis.texte: Great concept, nice packaging, but it can't remove even light makeup even after several attempts It ran out soo fast, I was dissappointed

**Received product in exchange for review** I enjoyed this product a lot. Its been about 2 months of testing it and I love the twist up top it seems so much more sanitary. The balm doesnt have the gritty texture that a lot of cleansing balms have which I prefer. It did a really good job of breaking down sunscreen and the majority of my makeup but it did struggle with my waterproof mascara which is kind of common with balms like this. Overall I would say of you are looking for a cleasning balm for day to day makeup wear this works really well but if you have a lot of waterproof makeup one cleanse will not be enough.

This cleansing balm works great! I tend to be extremely picky about my balms, they need to take off all my makeup without being a pain to rinse off. Thats exactly what this product does. Takes off ALL my makeup and super easy to rinse off. I also LOVE the packaging. It makes it so easy and mess free. Will definitely repurchase!!

This cleansing balm by Rael Beauty is luxurious. You can twist it and it will dispense the cleansing balm. What stood out to me was how soft and smooth it was and also how soft and smooth it made my skin feel. My skin felt so clean but not stripped of it's natural oils to a point where it feels dry and itchy. I was surprised by this since most cleansers do the opposite to my skin. Other things that stood out to me is that it's Dermatologist tested. It has heartleaf extract & cherry blossom extract which is safe for sensitive skin. It also doesn't dispense too much where you feel that you are wasting product. I also noticed that my skin cleared up and looked brighter after using. It does not have a fragrance. This is good for those with sensitive noses. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

i really loved the product!! i loved how as soon as i applied it to my skin it instantly melted and took off ALL my makeup in just one rinse !! i loved the scent it and i loved how it was not overally fragrant since i thought it was going to have a strong scent due to the cherry blossom but it was not strong whatsoever and i personally love that. it helped me unclog my pores as well !! i felt like it left my skin feeling hydarted and very clean. i really enjoyed the pretty color of the product i loved the pink !! i really like the packaging of the product because its not messy and enjoyable. i feel like cleansing balms do tend to get messy and dirty but with this packaging its the complete opposite. received as a part of an educational promotion.

I've been using this cleansing balm for a few weeks now, and I'm honestly so impressed! From the first use, it melted my makeup off effortlessly without leaving my skin dry or patchy. I have pretty dry skin, so finding something that actually cleans while keeping my face soft and hydrated is a big deal. The texture is buttery and smooth, and once it melts in, it turns into this silky oil that feels so luxurious. My skin feels clean, nourished, and super refreshed after every use. I also love that it's scent-free and gentle enough for sensitive skin. The twist-up design is such a smart idea — no mess and easy to control how much I use each time. I received this product for educational purposes in exchange for my honest review, and honestly, I'd 100% repurchase it!

avis.titre: An Innovative Approach to Makeup Removal
avis.texte: The Rael Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm is an oil-based makeup remover designed as the essential first step in a double-cleansing routine. Breaking away from the traditional cleansing balm jar, Rael introduces an ingenious twist-up stick format that dramatically improves hygiene and portability. Marketed as a gentle yet effective dissolver of makeup, sunscreen, and impurities, this Korean-beauty inspired formula is infused with calming and balancing botanicals tailored for sensitive and combination skin types. ​Packaging and Application Experience (5/5 Stars) ​The most striking feature of this product is its innovative, mess-free packaging. Cleansing balms typically require dipping fingers or a spatula into a tub, which can feel unhygienic and cumbersome, especially when traveling. Rael solves this problem with a twist-up stick mechanism, dispensing a precise amount of solid balm with a simple turn. The manufacturer suggests a half turn for light makeup and a three-quarter turn for a heavier look. ​When applied directly to dry skin, the solid balm instantly melts into a silky, lightweight oil upon contact with the warmth of the face. The application is smooth, requiring minimal tugging, which is crucial for preventing unnecessary stress on the skin, particularly around the delicate eye area. The product has a very mild, almost indiscernible scent, making it an excellent choice for those sensitive to artificial fragrances. ​Performance and Efficacy (4.5/5 Star

I've been using this cleansing balm lately, and I'm honestly obsessed with how easy and satisfying it is to use! I love how it shaves off thin little pieces when you twist it up, it keeps me from using too much, so it's definitely going to last me a good while. The balm literally melts into my skin the second I start rubbing it in. It's got this buttery, smooth texture that just feels super nice on my skin, which makes me want to play with it every time I use it! Haha. It melts away my makeup without drying me out, which is a plus because my skin is so dry! It also makes my face feel super soft and clean afterward. I really like that it's scent-free also, so it's gentle enough for sensitive skin. The colors of the balm are so pretty, the mix of pink and white looks like flower petals when it twists out. Speaking of twist! This is a great design; I wish more brands used this twist method! I don't have to worry about dipping my hands in or squeezing too much out. It dispenses the perfect amount that you can adjust to what you need or prefer. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

This product was given in exchange for an honest review. As someone who's constantly testing beauty products, I can confidently say this cleansing balm is a game-changer. From the first use, I noticed how effortlessly it melted away every trace of makeup, soothed my skin and left me feeling moisturized. The texture feels rich and buttery, but once massaged in, it transforms into a silky oil that leaves my skin feeling deeply cleansed yet hydrated. It's like giving your skin a mini spa treatment every night. 🌿 I love that the product stays pure with the twist top and emulsifies to wash all the old makeup, dirt and impurities away. The subtle botanical scent feels calming after a long day and the way my skin looks the next morning — soft, glowing, and balanced, never greasy. It's luxury in a jar!
I've been using this balm for a week straight and I love it!! It's a good cleanser and leaves your skin feeling super soft and smooth. It gets rid of impurities too and it's a good price

avis.titre: A Gentle Yet Effective Cleansing Balm That Truly Cares for
avis.texte: I've been using the Rael Beauty Miracle Clear Cleansing Balm for a while, and it's become one of my favorite gentle makeup removers. The heartleaf and cherry blossom extracts feel soothing on my sensitive skin — no redness or tightness afterward. The texture is smooth and buttery; it melts easily into the skin and rinses off cleanly without leaving any greasy film. The packaging is clever and hygienic with its twist-up design, though it's a bit bulkier than traditional balms. The scent is soft and floral, slightly sweet but not overpowering — very calming for an evening routine. In terms of effectiveness, it removes sunscreen and light makeup effortlessly, though heavy waterproof mascara may need a second cleanse. I appreciate that it's dermatologist tested and safe for sensitive skin, aligning with Rael's eco-conscious, clean-beauty philosophy. Overall, it's a refreshing, skin-kind balm that feels good to use and aligns with environmentally mindful skincare — both effective and gentle. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

avis.titre: good for what it is cleansing bomb
avis.texte: This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review. I thought the Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm was an okay product overall. It removed most of my makeup but not all of it, I still needed to follow up with another cleanser to get my skin completely clean. I did love how easy it was to use, especially the twist-up design, which made application simple and mess-free. The packaging is sleek, and the colors are beautiful, which makes it feel a bit more luxurious. It glided onto my skin smoothly and broke down my makeup fairly well, but it just didn't remove everything as effectively as I'd hoped. I wasn't using waterproof products, just regular and tubing mascara, and it still left some residue. It's convenient and gentle, but not a one-step cleanser for me.

Miracle Clear is the perfect name for this cleansing balm! It's gentle yet very effective. I was so surprised when I first tried it. I didn't even need to add water at first. The balm's texture melts into an oil that literally dissolves makeup without stripping the skin's natural moisture barrier. It's definitely my favorite to use when I have makeup on because it's just so effective. It doesn't really have a smell, which I love and it doesn't irritate my skin. My dry skin absolutely loves it! The packaging is awesome and perfect for travel, no need to worry about it leaking in your luggage. It's free from harsh sulfates, parabens and synthetic fragrances. I'm so happy I was introduced to this product! It will definitely be my go-to makeup remover balm (and travel essential). Love it!

I've been testing out Rael's new Purifying Twist Up cleansing balm for the past 2 weeks ago I like the product. This is a light balm that easily dispenses from the packaging with some greasy residue left behind. It was really easy to get the amount of balm I wanted though! In terms of the balm, it's a very basic balm that doesn't smell like anything to me and helped remove my makeup. It did not fog up my eyes at all, which I liked. I always double cleanse when I use an oil cleanser, but I found that it isn't absolutely necessary after this balm. This rinsed off well without a greasy residue left behind, but it left my skin slightly dry. My favorite part of this product is definitely the packaging as it more accessible than a squeezy tube and more hygienic than a jar, which I appreciate. I enjoyed my experience with this product. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

This cleansing balm is pretty good. The thing which I like the most about this is that it looks exactly like cherry blossom petals. They did a great job with the packaging too. It has to be twisted to get the product out which reduces product wastage. I had a full face of heavy makeup which came off easily when I removed it with this cleansing balm. It also leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated. The price is very good and affordable for the amount of product provided. I would recommend this to everyone who like using balm cleansers as it does remove makeup pretty well. I would definitely buy this again since it is so affordable and I get so much of product for such a good price. This product was received as part of an educational promotion.

I have heard of the brand Rael but never had the opportunity to try a product until now. And I will most definitely will be reaching for anything this brand comes out with! I cannot say enough good things about the Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm. I love that the jar has a twist up feature because unlike a push up jar, the twist allows you to control exactly how much you need. A lot of makeup removing products typically leave my skin feeling stiff and dry. I have sensitive skin that leans dry/normal. The last thing I want at the end of the day is dry my skin out even more. This formula does not do that!!! I was so pleasantly surprised that once I used water to emulsify the product that my skin actually felt hydrated?! If you're a sensitive/dry person this is most definitely going to be your new go to makeup remover. When I do wear makeup I opt for a full coverage look and this product was able to take off my full face swiftly. I didn't have to go back for more product or repeat the process. I have used other cleansing balms in the past and this is the only one where I felt I didn't have to use half the jar to get my makeup off! I will definitely be using this in my makeup removing routine from now on. I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Where have you been all my life?
avis.texte: I can't say enough good things about the Rael Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm. The packaging is genius. It's so easy to customize the amount of product you get. The best part is there is zero mess. No digging around for a spatula and getting the product everywhere. It also cuts out any wasted product. The packaging alone makes this amazing. Then you get to the formula, it's so good. I get zero eye fog or haze. I wear full glam every day and this melts away all of my makeup including my waterproof mascara. It isn't harsh or stripping and my skin feel soft and clean. This is my new goto Cleansing balm. I received this product in exchange for my honest view.

I received the Rael Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm as part of an educational promotion, and I've been using it for about two weeks now. Honestly, I wasn't expecting much, I've tried a lot of cleansing balms that either leave a weird residue or break me out. But this one surprised me in a good way. First off, the twist-up packaging is genius. It keeps things clean and mess-free, which I really appreciate. Most cleansing balms come in jars, and I don't love dipping my fingers in every time. This feels more hygienic and travel friendly. As for the product itself, it goes on super smoothly and melts into an oil quickly, which makes removing makeup, even stubborn waterproof mascara really easy. It doesn't tug or pull at the skin, and I haven't noticed any irritation. I have combination skin that's breakout prone, and this balm didn't cause any new flare ups. The scent is very mild, not too perfumey or overwhelming which is a big plus for me. After rinsing, my skin feels clean but not stripped, and it leaves a soft, almost moisturized finish. I still follow up with a gentle foaming cleanser to double cleanse, but I probably wouldn't have to.

Most cleansing balms come in jars which means scooping with fingers (or a spatula if you're fancy) inevitably making a mess, and sometimes introducing bacteria into the container. Rael took that concept and made it so much easier by putting it into a twist-up stick. It looks almost like a deodorant, but for your face. You just twist, swipe it directly onto dry skin, and let it melt away your makeup and sunscreen. It's simple, clean, and oddly satisfying.This balm takes off everything. Waterproof mascara, sunscreen, heavy foundation, the works. What's even better is that it does it without stripping the skin. After rinsing, my face doesn't feel tight or dry.

I am obsessed!! The twist-up dispenser is genius—it shaves off thin slices of balm as you turn, so you never waste product. It's unlike any packaging I've seen and makes cleansing surprisingly fun. My skin feels fresh, clean, and hydrated without any greasy residue. It melts away makeup effortlessly, even waterproof formulas, and a little goes a long way. The balm glides on smoothly and feels lightweight yet powerful. It is much more afforadable than other cleansing balms and in my opinion is just as good and the packaging makes it even better! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Fav first step to double cleansing
avis.texte: First, the twist up packaging is genius. SO much better than scooping out with my nail or leaving a spatula around. It feels way more sanitary and I know I'm using less product because its easier to control and see how much you're getting. The balm it melts everything off easily. It doesn't burn my eyes or leave that weird film some balms do. Its not drying even for someone who uses prescription retinol. I can literally see/feel the little white heads it clears out. Apparently my husband thought it was a moisturizer (told me he loved our new twisty moisturizer lol) and was rubbing it in without rinsing and didn't even break out. I've tried tons of balms and oils as my first step to double cleansing and this is my favorite! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: out with the old, in with the new!
avis.texte: When I received this, I already had a cleansing balm that I was pretty attached to and didn't think anything would top it. I figured this would just be another balm that does the job but doesn't feel special enough to make me switch. But after using it consistently, I realized it's actually better than the one I thought I loved. One of the first things I noticed was the packaging and the way it dispenses. Instead of dipping into a jar over and over, this balm twists up from the bottom, which lets you control exactly how much you're using. It sounds like a small thing, but it makes a big difference in keeping the product fresh and clean. No scooping with fingers, no worry about contamination, and no overusing by accident. I find that I end up using just the right amount every time, which also makes it last longer. The texture is a big win to me. A lot of balms I've tried in the past can feel heavy or almost waxy at first, and then they take a lot of effort to spread around before they start melting. This one is much thinner and blends into the skin almost immediately. It doesn't feel like I'm dragging or tugging to work it in. As soon as it touches my face, it starts breaking down the makeup without leaving behind that heavy layer some balms tend to have. It also smells lovely. The scent is light, not overpowering at all, but noticeable enough to feel fresh and enjoyable while I'm massaging it in. One of those scents you don't realize how much you enjoy until you start looking

I've been really enjoying the new Rael Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm! The packaging is genius - you just twist it up, and it dispenses the perfect amount of product. No digging into a jar or getting balm under your nails, which I love. The texture feels super lightweight and silky. It melts away makeup and sunscreen so easily, even waterproof mascara, without leaving that heavy or greasy film on the skin. My skin feels clean but still hydrated afterward, not tight or stripped. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free and gentle. My skin can be reactive, and this didn't cause any redness or irritation. It's packed with really nice ingredients like tamanu and jojoba oil to balance the skin, rice bran oil to nourish, and heartleaf extract to calm everything down. My only complaint is that you don't get a ton of product and I feel like I'll go through it very fast. But overall, such a smart and effective cleansing balm! It makes removing makeup at the end of the day feel quick, clean, and kind of fun. Received as a part of an educational promotion.

I'll just start by saying that I LOVE this product. It's just perfection. First, the packaging is outstanding. This is a thicker balm, and normally you would need to scoop something of this texture out of a jar with your fingers. This jar completely solves that problem. All you do is twist and the balm comes out through a slit in the top. It's ingenious!!! I would love to see this design used for other jarred products as well, such as moisturizers. I hate trying to keep track of that little plastic spoon that comes with them, so I end up just dipping my fingers in. Second, the product itself is fabulous. I always double cleanse at night, and this is the best oil-based cleanser I've used. The texture is excellent. Not too thick, not too oily. It feels great when on my skin and I feel that it provides moisture that lasts far after I've rinsed it off. The balm removes makeup and sunscreen easily, and it's also fragrance free. I honestly cannot say enough good things about this product, and I plan to keep purchasing. And bonus points for being a Korean brand, because I tend to gravitate toward Korean skincare. *I received this product as part of an educational promotion.

The twist-up mechanism is pure genius—no more scooping balm out of a jar. With tamanu and jojoba oils plus rice bran and heartleaf, it melts waterproof makeup and sunscreen smoothly, rinses clean without greasiness, and leaves skin feeling balanced and soft. - I received this as a part of an educational promotion

I've been so torn on how many stars to give this product. The product itself is average. I like that there's no fragrance. It leaves my skin relatively soft. It removes mascara well but didn't get all of my lipstick off off. I quite like the packaging - it's easy to dispense just the right amount, and you don't have to worry about sticking your fingers into a jar and the rest of the product harboring bacteria. The product itself is nice but nothing special in my opinion, it's the packaging that's the winner here. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I've been using the Rael Miracle Clear Cleansing Balm for a few weeks and I'm honestly impressed. The twist-up stick makes it super convenient no messy jars or scooping. It literally melts your makeup way, even waterproof mascara, and how hard it is to remove waterproof mascara. This cleanser leaves my skin soft instead of feeling stripped. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review..

This cleansing balm is fantastic but honestly the packaging is a major selling point for me. I've never seen another cleansing balm with a twist applicator before. This lets me get the perfect amount of product out for removing my makeup at night. It also feels way more sanitary compared to the normal jar packaging with a scoop (and let's be honest, I end up losing the scoop half the time and just using my fingers). The product itself works very well. I don't wear face makeup outside of blush and sunscreen but always have heavy eye makeup and waterproof mascara. I need a cleansing balm that doesn't require me to scrub harshly or pull at my eyes. This slides on smoothly and removes my makeup with minimal effort and never leaves any of my mascara behind. I follow up with my usual cleanser and my skin feels fresh and non-greasy. This is a 5 star product all around! I received this product for educational purposes in exchange for my honest review.
Its a very fun product to use! I love that you can twist the product with thin layers. Furthermore its super hygienic to use for those who have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Convenient Twist‑Up Balm For Light Makeup
avis.texte: The Rael Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm has a unique twist-up design which I found to be great for precise application and travel-friendly, all without the risk of a mess. The balm has a nice texture and applies smoothly, but I found myself needing more product than expected to effectively break down and remove makeup, especially waterproof or long-wear formulas. It does a decent job with light makeup or sunscreen, but for anything heavier, it struggled a bit. I followed up with a separate, light water-based cleanser to fully remove residue and leave my skin feeling clean. While it's a gentle option that didn't irritate my skin, I wouldn't rely on it alone for thorough cleansing. Good concept, but falls short in full makeup removal. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

I have received Raels cleansing balm as a part of an educational promotion and to say I am seriously impressed is such an understatement. Though I received this product as a promotion, I am so impressed with the packaging and the formula! I have dry skin and anything over cleans my skin and makes it dry, not this balm. It felt silky and left my face clean! 10/10 recommend!!
This is very effective balm to clean all the makeup and dirt from my skin. I love how it works very easily and effortlessly . Highly recommended

This Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm from Rael is the perfect makeup removing balm! Other balms I have tried are always messy getting them out of the tub- but not this one! The twist up feature is so cool! I love that it doesn't have a very strong scent to it as I have sensitive skin that doesn't enjoy overly fragranced skincare products. I have extremely dry skin and the cleansing balm doesn't strip my skin's oils or leave me feeling tight and crusty, which is a huge plus for me. It's oil based, so it melts off makeup very quickly and easily- even mascara! It doesn't irritate my eyes either, which I really appreciate. This is my new favorite cleansing balm! I received this product as a part of an educational promotion.

I have struggled with acne and redness for most of my life, so having a good cleaning routine is essential. This was my first time trying a cleansing balm as I was raised to keep my skin dry and not moisturized, so it would not break out. I have been focusing on, repairing my skin barrier, and finding good hydration that does not clog my pores. Rael Beauty purifying twist up cleansing balm Feels more like a spa treatment, then washing my face at night. The balm is delivered in small shavings. They're easy to scoop without the mess of digging into a jar. The product is extremely hydrating on my skin and easily dissolves my makeup, and any products throughout the day while still leaving my skin, feeling clean, and even nourished. The heart leaf extract is my favorite ingredient, since I am always dealing with redness, and finding a product that helps soothe the irritation is really important for me. I received this as part of an educational promotion.

I haven't used a balm cleansing stick before so I wasn't sure what to expect. I love it! This product goes on so easily and then you really see the magic when you apply the water. I was able to try for my honest review!

avis.titre: Nourishing balm that leaves skin soft and clean
avis.texte: I have mature, dry skin, and this balm cleansing is so gentle and hydrating. The product goes over makeup and SPF without drying or tugging on my skin. After rinsing, my face feels smooth and moist, not tight or greasy. It removes everything, including mascara, and leaves my skin with a healthy glow. Great as a first step in my evening routine. I received this product as a promotion for learning.

I absolutely love the Rael Beauty Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm! This cleansing balm is such a cool and unique product. The packaging immediately caught my attention and it's so convenient and mess free. I love how you just twist the bottom, and the balm smoothly comes out the top. It makes the whole process easy and clean, with no scooping or spilling. The balm itself works wonderfully and it melts away my makeup instantly and feels so soothing on my skin. My face always feels soft, moisturized, and completely clean after using it, without any greasy residue. It even helps remove stubborn eyelash glue, which is usually tough to get off, but this makes it so easy. I truly recommend this product to everyone because it's effective, fun to use, and leaves your skin feeling amazing! I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and unique application
avis.texte: I'm always on the hunt for a good makeup remover and tend to lean towards cleansing balms or oil cleansers so I was excited to try Rael Miracle Clear Purifying Twist-Up Cleansing Balm . The packaging is very unique and as it twist-up, ribbons of the cleansing balm come out. It's fun, travel-friendly, and practical. The balm itself has a smooth, buttery texture that glides easily over skin, melting makeup without tugging. For removing face makeup, it worked wonderfully leaving my skin soft with no residue. However for eye makeup, it leave a slight film and took a few times for it to come off. The best part of this product truly is the packaging for a cleansing balms. For me not having to stick my fingers in a jar and get too much or too little is a win! This product was given to me for educational purposes.

The Rael Beauty Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm removes effectively! This balm comes in a twist up container for easy usage. You can control the amount of product you want by turning it halfway or 3/4 of a turn. Using the product provides the luxury of not having to use several makeup removing wipes. This cleansing balm does not leave any stubborn makeup behind. It's perfect for sensitive skin and non irritant on the face. The texture is smooth and moisturizing. It includes cherry blossom and heartleaf extract and made in Korea. "I received this as a part of an educational promotion."

I' ve been using the Rael Twist Up Purifying Cleansing Balm for a few weeks now, and honestly, I'm impressed. The first thing I noticed was how easy and mess-free the twist-up stick design is. I love that I don't have to scoop anything out of a jar, it feels super clean and convenient, especially when I'm tired at night or rushing in the morning. The balm itself goes on really smoothly and melts into my skin as I massage it in. It breaks down makeup (even waterproof mascara!) and sunscreen without me having to scrub, which I appreciate. After rinsing, my skin feels soft and hydrated instead of greasy or tight like some other cleansers leave it. It's gentle but still makes my face feel completely clean. I also love that it has a light, fresh scent that isn't overpowering. My skin tends to be on the sensitive side, and this formula didn't cause any irritation or breakouts, just a nice clean, smooth feeling afterward. It's definitely become part of my regular routine, and the portable twist-up packaging makes it easy to take anywhere. If you're looking for a cleansing balm that's both effective and easy to use, this one's worth trying. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

The Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm has unique and eye catching packaging when you twist the product, it comes out in a pretty flower shape. It's almost odorless, which I appreciate since it doesn't have a strong or artificial scent.However, I was a bit disappointed with the results. After washing my face with the cleansing balm, my skin still felt somewhat dirty. When I followed up with toner on a cotton pad, I noticed a lot of residue left behind something that doesn't usually happen when I use other cleansers.

avis.titre: Effective at getting the job done.
avis.texte: I've been using the new Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm by Rael Beauty for a few weeks now, and so far, I've really been enjoying it. I love the twisted feature of this balm; it makes it super easy to get just the right amount without having to touch the entire product or risk spreading germs. It applies smoothly and evenly on the skin, and a little goes a long way. That being said, although I like the twist-up feature, the packaging is a little bulky for traveling with. It does a great job breaking down dirt, grime, and makeup off; and worked even water-proof makeup; leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean. I did notice a bit of a reaction the very first time I used it, even though it's designed for sensitive skin. I'm not sure if that was just a one-time thing, because when I tried it again later, I didn't have any issues. Still, if you have ultra-sensitive skin, it's something to keep in mind. Overall, I've been really happy with this cleanser. It's been an effective, new addition to my daily skincare routine. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

I'm Southeast Asian with light to medium skin that tans in the summer. I have regular skin that can get dry with active ingredients (AHAs, retinoids). I've been doing 10-step Korean skincare for 10 years now. It may seem excessive, but I live in a dry climate. I love to use balms for my double cleanse. I don't prefer the oils that come out of a pump because they just get so messy. This is the first time I had a twist up balm, though, which keeps it very hygienic (as opposed to a plastic spoon/scoop). I use micellar water to remove my waterproof make up. Then I begin my double cleanse. I love the cherry blossom and rice in the balm because it adds to the moisturizing ingredients. Double cleansing can by drying for some, so those ingredients definitely prevent oil stripping from the face. I was given this product for educational purposes.

avis.titre: Love the Twist-Up Format and Gentle Feel!
avis.texte: I received this balm as part of an educational promotion, and I really like its convenient twist-up stick format , no mess and easy to use. The packaging looks fresh and pretty too. The balm melts nicely into an oil and removes most of my makeup really well, leaving my skin soft and comfortable afterward , no dryness or tight feeling at all. However, it didn't completely remove my eye pencil, so I still had to use a separate eye makeup remover. Overall, it's a gentle and effective cleansing balm, especially great for dry or sensitive skin. I'll keep using it for daily cleansing, just not for heavy eye makeup.

This cleansing balm by Rael is absolutely incredible! First of all, the dispenser is so innovative! It dispenses the absolute perfect amount in a thin ribbon of product which is all you need to do a thorough job! The consitency is so lovely. It goes on creamy and then melts right into the skin and turns into a slightly oily cleanser that does a truly great job removing all of the makeup including any typically hard to remove products. The makeup just melts off leaving my skin so hydrated and clean. I love that this product has absolutely no scent and is so gentle on my skin. This will be my new go to product and i will be purchasing another to have as a backup too! I received this item complimentary in exchange for my honest review.

As someone with EXTREMELY dry skin I LOVE balm cleansers. This one is incredibly moisturizing and does a fantastic job at removing FACE makeup. However it's not too great at removing mascara. But as a girly with eczema flare ups on her face, this did a GREAT job at not only not stripping my skin and making it feel dry, but leaving my face feeling extremely moisturized!

This cleansing balm lasts forever and leaves my skin feeling so nice. It definitely gives me a more gentle cleanse yet it's super effective at removal. I haven't experienced any dryness, flakiness, stinging or congestion while using it and it doesn't take much. I dont have to rub my face too much and it's much quicker to remove everything. My skin doesn't feel dry or tight and there's no residue, every speck is removed effortlessly. The applicator is convenient and gives me the only dab I need and it works well. Although I received this complimentary in exchange for testing and review purposes, I'd say it's a nice choice and I would happily recommend it to everyone in the market for an effective cleanser. This particular method works.

This cleansing balm lasts forever and leaves my skin feeling so nice. It definitely gives me a more gentle cleanse yet it's super effective at removal. I haven't experienced any dryness, flakiness, stinging or congestion while using it and it doesn't take much. I dont have to rub my face too much and it's much quicker to remove everything. My skin doesn't feel dry or tight and there's no residue, every speck is removed effortlessly. The applicator is convenient and gives me the only dab I need and it works well. Although I received this complimentary in exchange for testing and review purposes, I'd say it's a nice choice and I would happily recommend it to everyone in the market for an effective cleanser. This particular method works.

I tried the Rael Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm for two weeks before giving my honest feedback. I used the product about every other day, for a total of 8 facial washes. I loved how my skin felt when I applied the product on my dry skin. It glided on my face and made all the makeup, mascara and SPF disappear before I washed it off. Due to trial and error, I definitely liked putting it on with dry skin better, rubbing away, and then washing it off. My skin did not feel greasy when the product was washed off and felt a bit moisturized after the cleanse. I will be recommending buying this product in the future because it removed all the gunk in my skin and my skin felt wonderful after using it. I will be reaching for this cleansing balm whenever I wear makeup, SPF and mascara. Please note, this product was gifted to me for an honest review.

I was gifted this product complimentary for my honest review. I really love how this just melts all the dirt and/or makeup away without stripping my skin. It leaves my skin so hydrated and nourished. It doesn't break me out. It takes my makeup off easily. Its so good and it's fragrance free. It doesn't irritate my eyes either. I absolutely love the packaging as well because its fun and hygienic. Great everyday cleanse.

This cleansing balm makes taking off makeup and sunscreen super easy at the end of the day. The texture starts out buttery and melts smoothly when massaged onto dry skin, rinsing off clean and fresh without any greasy film left behind whatsoever. My skin feels soft, balanced, and refreshed after cleansing, not tight or stripped like with other cleaners. The twist-up stick design keeps things neat and mess-free, which is perfect for travel or quick use at night. The light scent fades quickly and hasn't caused any irritation, and I've noticed my skin looking clearer and more even since adding it to my routine. It's a gentle, effective first cleanse that makes skincare feel simple and relaxing. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

avis.titre: THE product I have been looking for!!
avis.texte: The Rael Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm is THE product I have been looking for!! In the past, I tried other cleansing balms that weren't quite to my liking. Rael's Cleansing Balm removes makeup, sunscreen, and other impurities from the skin without leaving the oily/greasy feel that many others have. I normally use this cleansing balm before washing my face with a liquid cleanser and have found that it leaves my skin feeling significantly softer and more moisturized after washing. One of my favorite parts about this product is that it does an incredible job at removing false lashes (yes, I'm talking about that stubborn bond/seal for cluster lashes!). I also love using it with a cuetip to help correct any makeup mistakes (think liner, lipstick, etc) because I don't have to rinse it off and there's no residue left behind! The balm is white/rose in color, soft in texture, and doesn't have much of a smell to it either. This product was received in exchange for my honest review.

I was very impressed with this makeup remover. It works very effectively. I absolutely LOVE the twist up packaging. It reminds me a lot of a pencil sharpener. It just makes the experience more fun, which I really appreciate. I do wish this product had a bit more of a scent, preferably a cherry blossom fragrance, but that's a very minor complaint. I don't have to use a lot of product to remove my makeup so I know this will last me for a long time. I'm a cosplayer so I will definitely continue using this to take off my heavy makeup at the end of the day. I have very dry skin and this was gentle on my face. It didn't leave my skin feeling tight or irritated. Overall, I definitely recommend this makeup remover, whether you wear light makeup or heavy makeup. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I received this product as part of an educational promotion. First off, I love the dispenser. It's so easy to control the amount of product you get and you don't have to stick your fingers in the jar. Also, the balm is so light yet it really gets the job done - removing foundation, mascara, long-wearing liquid lipstick, the works. I'm a big fan!

avis.titre: Rael Beauty Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm
avis.texte: I recently tried the Rael Beauty Miracle Clear Purifying Twist Up Cleansing Balm and I must say, it's pretty impressive. The dispensing packaging is quite unique. It actually shaves off thin slices of the balm as you turn it, so you never use too much. I've never seen a dispenser like this before, and I've also never used a cleansing balm in general so this was a first. Even though it's oil based, it left my skin feeling surprisingly fresh and super clean without that stripped feeling most cleansers tend to cause. My skin stayed moisturized with no sticky residue afterward. It's lightweight, effective and its glide just feels different in the best way. I'm glad I got introduced to this product. It's definitely a cool alternative to traditional face washes.

I received this as a part of an educational promotion. I have never tried products of this brand before, but I have heard good reviews, so I am so glad that I was able to try products of this brand. I really liked this cleansing balm. The first thing I want to note is, of course, the packaging. The way the product is squeezed out is simply amazing. And this amount is just enough to cleanse your face and neck. I think you'll use a small amount and it will last a long time. The product itself also delivers on its promises; after cleansing, skin feels clean but not too dry. It's scentless, which may be good for sensitive skin or for people who don't like fragrances. I also want to note that the product is dermatologist-approved, which is great. I think I'll definitely buy this product again.
I love using this product!! Not only is the application fun, but it truly has made such a difference in my skin care routine! I highly recommend this and will definitely continue using it
